rule: An old scheme name resolves to the renamed fund. key is normalize(oldName).join(' '). An alias applies only where its target is one of the candidates being matched, after the stable identifiers and the exact vendor key and before the exact normalised name. It covers the Regular and Direct plans: a holding whose own name says Direct takes the direct target, any other the regular target. requiresPhrase, when present, must appear in the holding's own name (lower case, spaces collapsed), or the alias does not apply. Every line needs the owner's approval (OD-5, PD-36), with public evidence. Line 10 of the evidence list (Aditya Birla SL Equity Advantage Fund) is on hold and deliberately absent. The file's approved date is that of lines 1 to 17 (the owner, 25 Nov 2026). A line approved later carries its own approved date and approvedBy: lines 18 to 22 were approved by the owner on 28 Nov 2026 ("Approve all five"). Those five are not renames: each oldName is AMFI's official spelling of a scheme that the vendor data spells differently, tied to the target by AMFI's scheme code, and renamed is null.
